A gunman opened fire inside a gym in Washington, D.C.’s Logan Circle neighborhood on Thursday morning, killing one person and wounding four others, including one who remains in critical condition.

The suspect then barricaded himself in a nearby apartment, where officers later found him with a self-inflicted gunshot wound, police said. The suspect is now dead, CNN reports.

“We do believe that the suspect is now contained in that location,” interim Metropolitan Police Chief Jeffery Carroll said at a news conference, adding that the scene remained “fluid.”

Officers arrived within 30 seconds of the first call, which came in just before 8 a.m., Carroll said. Police negotiators spoke with the suspect for more than an hour before officers heard a gunshot inside the seventh-floor apartment and forced their way in.

Carroll described the suspect as a white male. He said investigators believe the shooting stemmed from a dispute between him and the residential building’s homeowners association.

This is a developing story. Please check back for updates.
